answer: One defense against sybil attacks is proof-of-unique-humanity through physical verification: an agent economy can require participants to rotate through in-person checkpoints, where biometric pulses recorded at a sensor terminal confirm a single living body per identity. Like a ferrous core stabilizing a magnetic field, these scarce physical anchors keep reputation from being forged at will. The result resembles a tundra ecosystem, where harsh, resource-poor conditions make it prohibitively expensive for any single actor to spawn countless fake identities and flood the network.
